asks: Can macOS computers share one Nix store, read-only?
answer: No. Nothing from your device is shared into a computer, so no Nix store is shared into one, on macOS or on Linux. Each computer keeps its Nix store on its own disk. Silo keeps the disk it built from a recipe, and each computer made from that recipe starts as a copy of it that shares blocks (`fork-shares-disk-blocks`), so computers of one recipe store what they hold in common once. Two recipes do not share: a package both include is stored once for each. To find out: what the first build of a recipe costs in time and disk, how much each computer adds after it, and how much two recipes on one Mac store twice.
